title: alchemilla vulgaris f. fallax
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris f. fallax, commonly known as the alpine lady's mantle or lady's mantle, is a rare variety of the alchemilla vulgaris plant, a flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may exhibit antimicrobial, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of alpine lady's mantle, such as tannins and glycosides, may contribute to its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
